send.name: Send SMS
send.description: Send an SMS through the Huawei modem.

add_contact.name: Add SIM contact
add_contact.description: Add a contact to the SIM phone book.

delete_contact.name: Delete SIM contact
delete_contact.description: Delete a contact from the SIM phone book.

enable_pin.name: Enable SIM PIN
enable_pin.description: Requires the current PIN (4–8 digits). An incorrect PIN consumes an attempt and can block the SIM. No automatic retries.

disable_pin.name: Disable SIM PIN
disable_pin.description: Requires the current PIN (4–8 digits). An incorrect PIN consumes an attempt and can block the SIM. No automatic retries.

change_pin.name: Change SIM PIN
change_pin.description: Requires the current PIN (4–8 digits). An incorrect PIN consumes an attempt and can block the SIM. No automatic retries.

get_pin_status.name: Read SIM PIN status
get_pin_status.description: Read SIM/PIN status and remaining attempts when available. Does not reveal the PIN. States are raw modem codes.

verify_pin.name: Unlock SIM with PIN
verify_pin.description: Submit the PIN after modem startup without disabling PIN protection. An incorrect PIN consumes an attempt. No automatic retries.

user.title: Connect to a Huawei HiLink modem
user.description: The connection test only reads the SMS counter.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one modem is supported in this version.

data_description.allowed_senders: One number per line. Leave empty to disable SMS commands.
data_description.interactions_file: Absolute path to the allow-listed entity mapping.

error.invalid_phone_number: Enter valid phone numbers, one per line.
